## DA Integration 2.0.4 for Minecraft 26.3 (Fabric)

Bugfix release on top of 2.0.3.

### Fixes

- The game no longer closes when you change the menu scale in settings (ImGui assertion `WindowBorderHoverPadding > 0`) ([#16](https://github.com/bUmmy1337/da-integration/pull/16)).

### For addon developers

- New [wiki on making addons](https://github.com/bUmmy1337/da-integration/tree/main/docs/wiki) and an example addon in `Modifications/ExampleAddon` ([#15](https://github.com/bUmmy1337/da-integration/pull/15)).

### Installation

1. Install Fabric Loader 0.19.5+ for Minecraft 26.3 and Fabric API.
2. Replace the old mod jar in your `mods` folder with `daintegrate-2.0.4.jar`.

For everything new in 2.0, see the [2.0.1 release](https://github.com/bUmmy1337/da-integration/releases/tag/26.3_2.0.1).
